records.source: ``wait`` is off by default. The freeze this module was written for came from statting remembered paths -- a passive pass over everything a settings file mentions, on the GUI thread, to colour the missing ones red. No user action waits on that pass, so answering from cache and checking later costs nothing.
records.context: ``wait`` is off by default. The freeze this module was written for came from statting remembered paths -- a passive pass over everything a settings file mentions, on the main GUI execution path, to colour the missing ones red. No user action waits on that pass, so answering from cache and checking later costs nothing.
records.translation: ``wait`` er sjálfgefið óvirkt. Frystingin sem þessi eining átti að leysa kom frá stat-athugunum á vistuðum slóðum — yfirferð á GUI-þræðinum yfir allt sem stillingaskrá nefnir, til að lita slóðir sem vantaði rauðar, án sérstakrar notandaaðgerðar. Engin aðgerð notandans bíður eftir þessari yfirferð, svo að svara úr skyndiminni og athuga síðar veldur engri viðbótarbið.
